note: Visual rescue check for scripts/brain_probe.py. The spec'd pool (superclass=="ol_sensory") is entirely histaminergic, and connectome.SIGN maps histamine to -1, so all 6,091 photoreceptors are inhibitory. This LIF has no spontaneous activity, so an inhibitory input layer has nothing to modulate and the rest of the brain emits exactly zero spikes at every window and drive tried (see propagation_diagnostics). That is a property of the model's sign convention plus its silent baseline, not evidence about DN coding, so two excitatory visual pools are run alongside it and flagged deviation_from_spec=true.
se_note: At n=600 the CV standard error is ~0.020 and taking the best of a 6-value C grid inflates accuracy by a further ~0.03-0.05; the permuted-label probe in each run measures that inflation directly. Treat a readout as carrying information only if it beats its permuted-label baseline by >= 0.06.

conditions_explained.raw_bits: logistic probe straight on the binary feature vector, no brain
conditions_explained.channel_ceiling: active driven cells per (type|side) channel of the driven pool; no simulation. Analogue of brain_probe's glomerular_ceiling.
conditions_explained.real:INPUT: spike counts of the 1,800 driven visual neurons (sanity)
conditions_explained.real:LC: lobula-columnar visual projection neurons, intermediate stage
conditions_explained.real:DN: descending neurons, the readout under test
conditions_explained.shuffled:*: edge targets globally permuted, in-degree preserved. Not a null: permuting post hands the DNs near-direct input, i.e. a sparse random projection with no recurrence.
conditions_explained.permuted_label:*: same pipeline and same best-of-C-grid on shuffled labels; the honest chance level.

reproduction_check: Dataset and CV are identical to outputs/probe_primary_w50_d30.json, so raw_bits must be 0.9 (label A) and 0.8533 (label B). probe() here is brain_probe.probe with n_jobs=1 instead of -1 (one process, as required); the CV is deterministic so results are unaffected.

label_A.kind: count of bits in a random 12-bit group >= k

label_B.kind: random Gaussian-weighted linear threshold on 10 bits

intensity_only_decoder.note: Same probe on a single feature: the total number of active bits. Any readout that only encodes total input intensity can reach this accuracy for free.
intensity_only_decoder.implication: real:DN under optic_excitatory drive is 0.6017 (A) / 0.54 (B), i.e. AT OR BELOW the 0.6283 an intensity-only decoder gets on A, so the 0.048 lift over the permuted baseline on label A is intensity leakage, not identity.

driven_cell_out_edges_by_target_supercla.note: Where the drive can go in one hop. Confirms optic_excitatory is a visual-pathway injection (21.4% of its out-edges go to visual_projection neurons) rather than a short-path bypass into the central brain (2 direct descending_neuron edges).
